title: Yellowed Crunchy Polish Sausage Skillet
description: A festive Polish dish featuring crunchy sausage and a hint of grassy flavor, made with dijon mustard and score-fat for a low-glycemic friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the score-fat in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
Add the Polish sausage to the skillet and cook until it is browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add the dijon mustard, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
